summary: Rabbi Harari explores the halakhic definition of the word "bayit" (home) in the context of the mitzvah of Nerot Hanukkah. He examines whether the obligation is tied to the individual or the home by analyzing various Rishonim, including the Ran, Tosafot, and Rashi, and discusses the implications for those who are traveling or camping during the holiday.
questions: Is the obligation of Nerot Hanukkah on the person or on the home?
If I am traveling or camping on Hanukkah, am I obligated to light candles?
Why do we light Hanukkah candles in our homes rather than only in the synagogue?
What is the purpose of Birkat HaRoeh, and when is it recited?
Does the requirement for a home in the mitzvah of Hanukkah mirror the laws of mezuzah?
